brief.title: Check official sources for new laws and rules on a topic
brief.plain_summary: Read each official source in the watch profile through the access its terms permit, record how it was read, and list new laws and rules on the topic since the given date.
brief.outcome: Candidate rules with every source checked, or blocked when a source's terms forbid automated reading.

since.description: Find rules published on or after this date.

output_store.description: Store for the produced nouns. The default is a placeholder; use the store your owner assigned.

output_contract.delivery: Write produced nouns surface_only under your own authenticated surface, which is the requester's assigned surface, so the requester and that surface's reviewers can read them. Never use public_commons or allowlist other surfaces. Return every produced noun's pin in output.artifacts; add its value when the requester asks for inline delivery.

outcome_meanings.sources_checked: The declared nouns were produced and every deterministic acceptance check passed.
outcome_meanings.no_change: The evidence does not justify producing or changing anything. Say why.
outcome_meanings.unknown: The question could not be answered with the permitted inputs. List what is missing and what would resolve it.
outcome_meanings.blocked: A required input, permission or capability is missing. Ask one precise question.

acceptance_checks.check: The output validates against template.rule-candidates's schema.
Every source checked records its access method and the date its terms were read.
Every source checked is named in the watch profile.

creates.nouns: The worker writes the nouns listed in output_contract.produces and returns their pins.
creates.verbs: The worker proposes follow-up verbs in output.proposed_verbs, such as a breakdown into smaller verbs or a research follow-up, with the pins they need. Proposals are never enqueued by the worker; an authorized requester enqueues the ones worth doing.

required: Read each source's terms before reading the source, and stop with blocked if they forbid automated reading.
Read only through the official access the source offers.
List each new law or rule with its official link and publication date.
Return follow-up work the results justify as proposed_verbs and nouns worth creating later as proposed_nouns. Never enqueue them yourself; an authorized requester decides which to run.

required_capabilities: write candidate nouns in the requester's scope
